args.title: Cold-Chain 2026: Combined Summary (Brightline article + companion)
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of the Brightline cold-chain piece and its companion:

- Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilots cut claims by a quarter.

Sources:
- https://blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain
- https://insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion (accessed via free registration using priya.adeyemi@northwind.example)
